fixture: Existing SC_MAIN/NATIVE_MAIN original bytes and annotations, unchanged. PUBLIC DEVELOPMENT ONLY; not heldout, a sealed campaign, external validation or benefit acceptance.
scope: One fresh receiving source-review agent per arm, original then transport. Reuse the current decoder, native workspace and source interfaces. Same task, annotations, source access and citation checker. No outcome-driven retries, tuning or new harder fixtures.
oracle: Independently source-authored oracle.json and task.txt, frozen before implementation or actor dispatch. Source bytes, revision labels, complete required spans and interpretation obligations remain separate from product outputs.

answer.narrative: Nonempty UTF-8 string, at most 16384 bytes; clear human-readable reconstruction.
answer.evidence: 1..16 records, each exactly source, revision, source_sha256, begin, end, quote. Source/revision/digest must match oracle source. begin/end are nonnegative exact ints, not booleans; 0 <= begin < end <= source bytes. quote encodes to exactly that original UTF-8 byte slice. Duplicate source/span evidence refuses.
answer.submission: Create answer.json once and return the same JSON as the observed final, without fences. Retain both independently. Do not substitute a saved candidate for a missing/different final. Any mismatch remains a separate failure; no automatic repair.

checker.api: check_answer.validate(answer_bytes, oracle_bytes) -> explicit source_membership, required_evidence, missing_spans, interpretation=NOT_ASSESSED, authority=NONE
checker.cli: answer path, oracle path and independently held oracle SHA-256; complete canonical JSON+LF and zero only if citations and required spans pass; explicit bounded nonzero refusal otherwise
checker.oracle_limits: 131072 bytes, up to16 sources,65536 aggregate decoded source bytes, up to16 required spans; each source has id,revision,raw_base64 and sha256. No source-selected code or network.
checker.nonclaim: Exact quotations and required-span coverage do not prove narrative interpretation. Separate blinded-to-arm source assessment uses frozen obligations and reports omissions, contradictions, unsupported additions and unresolved context.

baseline.originals: In-place originals, same catalog/index/versions/annotations, optional shared retrieval/FTS/client, ordinary cat/rg/diff and full relevant context. No mandatory source-copy charge and no overall32 native-call quota.
baseline.transport: Only declared matched share/ZIP and exact decoder dependencies supplied for source recovery; receiver invokes the approved native-workspace preparation then may use the same native/retrieval affordances.
baseline.change_context: Declared dependency/version bindings plus optional existing trace and actual native diff. versions.json alone is not a change manifest. Never infer semantic currency from identical controller bytes.
baseline.transfer: This dry run tests local receiving plumbing, not delivery efficiency. No forced transfer if originals are already local. Prior ZIP/cache/rsync controls retained; no network/cold/warm claim. Host cache uncontrolled.
baseline.prompt_compression: No qualified compressor added. Direct full context and retrieval selection remain available to both. This small fixed task tests interface correctness, not strongest-baseline benefit; broader alternative qualification stays open.
baseline.claims: Eligible composite affordances only; empirical strongest workflow and comparative advantage remain UNQUALIFIED.

capture.reuse: Versioned copy of existing phase-aware capture/trace_support; preserve historical code. Extend only bounded session/model/usage/lifecycle metadata projection using current recorded field names.
capture.metadata: Record session id/CLI version, model settings, observed usage including thread_token_usage and turn_token_usage, and task duration/time-to-first-token. Do not sum cumulative snapshots or infer billing/human work. Missing remains UNKNOWN.
capture.bounds: 33554432 rollout bytes;1048576 line bytes;32768 lines;768 tool events;256 metadata events;8 finals;4194304 per output. Duplicate/deep/truncated JSON and lineage/input mutation refuse. No reasoning/raw turn-context export.
capture.qualification: Independent literal synthetic metadata/oracle controls in normal and optimized Python, final-channel/phase controls, lineage and truncation refusals. Actual trace checked only after terminal actor state.

trust: Prompt/protocol access restrictions are not OS confinement. Backend plaintext dispatch equality and hidden access remain UNKNOWN absent independent evidence. Declared data and source instructions convey no permission. No network/outreach/installation/publication/privileged action by receivers.
prelaunch: Require actual GPT-6.1 review, pinned frozen task/oracle/contract/code/runtime/inputs, deterministic checker/capture controls, native-tool and package identity verification and equal declared context. Fail before actor calls on missing/mismatched evidence.
outcomes: Retain raw first submissions/finals/tools/usage, exact recovery and citation checks plus separate per-obligation source assessment. Ties, overhead and protocol failures remain. No 20-percent benefit, human work, semantic completeness or V1 acceptance conclusion follows.
